Blaze and AJ discover a mud-loving monster truck in the woods and set out on an adventure to bring their new friend to Mud Fest.

title: Santiago of the Seas
description:
S02 E26 — Lost and Flounder; Rumble in the Jungle
Lorelai accidentally loses a magical Merlandian artifact and retraces her steps in order to recover it; when Lorelai's sister learns of a treasure chest containing the Lost Pearls of Merlandia, she enlists the Pirate Protectors to help find them.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E01 — Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E09 — Pups Stop a Gold Finding Machine; Pups Help Mayor Humdinger Out of a Jam
The PAW Patrol springs into action when a digging machine goes out-of-control and takes Uncle Otis on a wild ride; Digi and Tal try to help Mayor Humdinger but leave the Mayor covered in jam, so the Pups must rescue him from hungry animals.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E09 — Pups Save a Dragon; Pups Save the Three Little Pigs
Marshall wakes from a nap to find a real, fire-breathing dragon guarding a sleeping Katie in the Lookout Tower; the pups build a house for three little piglets.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E09 — Pups Save a Sleepwalking Bear; Pups Save Dude Ranch Danny
The pups need to get a sleepwalking bear back home before he wakes up; Daring Danny X takes his horse off the trail and ends up on a wild ride.

title: DORA
description:
Volleybull!; Diferente es Excelente
Dora and Boots help Benny master a move before the championship volleyball game; Dora and Boots meet Dulce the dragon heading to school, showing her differences make everyone special.

title: DORA
description:
Gaucho Games / Princesa Dora
Dora and Boots help their friend Catalina the Condor become a Gaucha and save the Gaucho Games; Dora and Boots meet Pilar the Princess Unicorn and help her get back to Unicorn Land.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Clubhouse Takeaway; Walkie Talkies; Peppa's Office; What Babies Do; Lenses
Suzy describes a takeout meal she had; Grandpa Pig creates a watering system; Mummy and Daddy Pig work hard in their home office; Peppa visits Cousin Chloe's house to play; at the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Indoor Adventure; New TV; Cushion Den; House Rules; Peppa's Office
A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans, so they decide to take it inside; Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks; on a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Pumpkin Party; Pumpkin Competition; Castle; Gerald Giraffe; Night Animals
Daddy Pig throws a Halloween costume party; everyone gathers their pumpkins for a pumpkin competition; the family visits a castle; Gerald Giraffe makes friends; Peppa and George stay up late to hunt for slugs and snails.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

The family plans a special day for George's birthday; Suzy Sheep comes over to play with Peppa; Peppa and George are painting; Peppa and George visit their cousin; Grandpa Pig builds a train.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E05 — Air Pups
The Pups must come to the rescue when a family of monkeys scatters into the jungle after being scared off by lava erupting from a volcano.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E08 — Pups Save the Dizzy Dust Express; Pups Save the Treetop Trekkers
When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers; Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E04 — Mission PAW: Quest for the Crown
Chase and the team get called to Barkingburg to keep an eye on the crown.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E19 — Pups Save a Super Pup; Pups Save Ryder's Robot
Rubble gets into trouble while pretending to be a super pup; the PAW Patrol must help Ryder find his robot pup.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E23 — Pups and the Beanstalk; Pups Save the Turbots
Ryder and the pups must keep Giant Alex busy so that he does not cause damage in Adventure Bay; the PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot's cousin.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E11 — Pups Save the Land Pirates; Pups Save the Birdwatching Turbots
When pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta set sail into the desert and become lost, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the land pirates; Cap'n Turbot and Francois chirp for help when a bird-watching contest leaves them up in the air.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E20 — Pups Save the Mayor's Race; Pups Save an Outlaw's Loot
Mayor Humdinger plans to cheat in the annual Mayor's Race; Ryder and Mayor Goodway find a treasure map while sorting through the old cabin of Outlaw Wild Wilbur.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E12 — The Crew Builds a Sporting Goods Store; The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer
The crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley launch Builder Cove's first sporting goods store; the pups step in to help Farmer Zoe move a watermelon.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E02 — The Crew Builds Sierra Sparkle's Bedroom; The Crew Builds A Water Ski Jump
Rubble and crew has a sleepover with Sierra Sparkle, but while surprising Sierra with a bedroom renovation, her favorite stuffy goes missing; when Mayor Greatway hurts her foot, the pups construct a special chair to help her do a huge waterski stunt.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E06 — Pups on Ice; Pups and the Snow Monster
Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jake's mountain; the pups find strange footprints in the snow on the mountain outside Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E14 — Pups Save a Bat Family; Pups Save a Mud Monster
The PAW Patrol works to free a bat family after a rock slide traps them inside their cave; snowboarders on Jake's Mountain become stuck on a broken chairlift while a monster is on the loose.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E24 — Pups and the Lighthouse Boogie; Pups Save Ryder
When a storm sends Mayor Goodway's rowboat drifting out to sea, the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue; Ryder gets stranded while trying to rescue a goat who is stuck on the edge of a cliff.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E04 — Pup Pup Boogie; Pups in a Fog
Rubble hurts his paw while trying to fix the train tracks; Ryder and the PAW Patrol must fix the bulb in the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

description:

description:

description:

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Around the World; Castle; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue
Miss Rabbit lends Peppa and her family a plane for the day, and they get swept off on an adventure around the world; the family visits a castle; when Miss Rabbit's train breaks down, Grandpa Pig lends her his little train, Gertrude.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Roller Disco; Weather Station; Talking; Grandpa's Rock Garden; Winter Games
Madame Gazelle has organized a roller disco; the children learn about the weather; there is a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama; Grandpa Pig is making a rock garden; Peppa and family go skiing.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Sibling School; Patchwork Quilt; New Baby; Baby Names; Holding the Baby

title: Peppa Pig

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat does not get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig.

description:
Parachute Jump; Miss Rabbit's Taxi; Playing Pretend; Scooters; George's Racing Car
The school roof is leaking, so Mummy Pig does a parachute jump to raise money to fix it; Miss Rabbit spends the day picking people up and dropping people off in her job as taxi driver.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Nursery Rhymes; Digger World; The Doll Hospital; Wendy Wolf's Birthday; Princess Peppa
Madame Gazelle and the playgroup share their best nursery rhymes; Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to Digger World, where they build walls and knock them over again.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Rocky's Cat-astrophe
When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best of Rubble
Rubble joins the PAW Patrol; Ryder helps keep a giant busy; corn maze; Jake is trapped in a cave; Mayor Humdinger steals a treasure map; Rubble gets into trouble; a train is trapped by a rockslide; Rubble and Marshall lead the PAW Patrol Band.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S01 E10 — Pups and the Ghost Pirate
The PAW Patrol attend a Halloween party on an old pirate ship; the pirate ship begins to head out to sea.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E13 — Pups Save a Freaky Pup-Day; Pups Save a Runaway Mayor
Chase and Chickaletta switch bodies and must learn to work together to return Cap'n Turbot's boat to the bay; Mayor Humdinger creates robotic pants to cheat at the Most Amazing Athlete Contest, but his invention soon goes haywire.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E23 — Moto Pups: Pups Save a Moto Mayor
Mayor Goodway thinks she can change the Ruff-Ruff pack's naughty ways by pretending to be a bad biker and becoming part of their gang; but when Gasket puts the Mayor through a battery of tough tests, it's up to the Moto Pups to rescue her.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E04 — Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups vs. Three Super Baddies
Super baddies Harold, Ladybird and the Copycat team up and take the Mighty Pups' mighty meteor; the Mighty Pups must get their meteor back and charge up to stop them before the team of baddies destroys Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E08 — Pups Save Bedtime; Pups Save Chickaletta's Egg
The Turbots are trapped somewhere in the jungle, but their phone cuts out when they try to call the PAW Patrol; after Chickaletta lays an egg, it rolls away and heads through town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E20 — Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack
Stunt motorcyclist Wild Cat joins the patrol to try to keep Ruff-Ruff Pack troublemakers from trashing the town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
Best Pet Rescues
Mayor Goodway compliments Rubble's construction skills; Katie's kittens are all covered in mud and running amok; Marshall's new pet frog, Smiley, enters a jumping contest; Ryder and the pups rescue Farmer Al's pig after he sails off.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E20 — Pups and the Power of Flowers; Pups Save the Alien Egg Hunt
A jealous Mayor Humdinger tries to swipe the florist's Easter decorations and winds up on a runaway wagon with Mayor Goodway; mysterious Alien Easter Eggs cause trouble in Adventure Bay.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E13 — Fire Rescue Pups and the Missing Water Mystery; Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin
Mr. Park's rooftop garden catches fire and there's no water in Adventure Bay; a trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E08 — Pups Save the Bookmobile; Pups Save Heady Humdinger
When Ms. Marjorie brings her bookmobile to Everest and the kids of the mountains, Maynard accidentally sets the van rolling and goes off on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger carves his face into the cliffs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E11 — Big Truck Pups Save the Swiped Speakers; Big Truck Pups Save the Big Big Pipes
When Mayor Humdinger hijacks Al's big rig carrying Luke Stars and his concert equipment, it's up to the pups to rescue him; when Al's load of pipes breaks loose, it's up to the pups to save their friends from the rolling hazards.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E15 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save a Giant Chicken; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Stop Harold's Deep Freeze
The Mighty Twins join the Mighty Pups to save a giant chicken and the town; the Mighty Pups have to stop Harold Humdinger before he puts Adventure Bay in a deep freeze so he can become mayor.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E18 — Mission PAW: Pups Save a Royal Concert; Mission PAW: Pups Save the Princess' Pals
Luke Stars goes missing before his Royal Concert in Barkingburg and Sweetie attempts to take over the event; animals overrun Barkingburg Castle while the Princess is away, forcing Ryder and the "PAW Patrol" to get them under control.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E16 — Pups Save the Trick-or-Treaters; Pups Save an Out of Control Mini Patrol
During Halloween in Adventure Bay, a mysterious kid in a giant spider costume takes all the treats from the trick-or-treaters; Alex and his Mini-Patrol accidentally take off on Daring Danny's rocket bike.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E13 — Pups Save a Lost Gold Miner; Pups Save Uncle Otis From His Cabin
Uncle Otis takes a trip to gold mine; Uncle Otis installs a Smart Home 3000 in his cabin that ends up trapping him and Mr. Wingnut inside.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E19 — Aqua Pups Save a Merdinger; Aqua Pups Save the Whale Patroller
When Humdinger disguises himself to steal the purple pearl, the PAW Patrol must return it to Puplantis; after Moby steals the Whale Patroller and all the Pups' vehicles with it, the pups climb aboard sea creatures to chase it down.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E26 — Pups Save Thundermouth; Pups Save a Class Pet
Shortly after listening to the story of Thundermouth, the pups are on a mission to save elephants spooked by a scary noise; Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E04 — The Good, the Sad, and the Grumpy!
When Mr. Grumpfish turns up in Happy Junction, he makes everyone in town really grumpy; Sheriff Molly must find a way to help everyone handle their tricky emotions.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E08 — A Furry Tale!
Hansel and Gretel have to get Bubble Puppy and Bubble Kitty home safe to the Furry Godmother, but they're being stalked by a witch.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E14 — The Big Rig Bandit!
When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E16 — Sleeping UmiCar
Team Umizoomi is visiting their friend Zeppo the Wizard; when Zeppo's magic sleeping potion makes UmiCar fall asleep, it's up to the team to get the ingredients for the wake-up potion.

title: Team Umizoomi
description:
S04 E01 — The Boy With the Dragon Skateboard
When the TroubleMakers break Logan's skateboard, the team must find all the pieces and help him put his skateboard back together.
